title: Insufficient suffix length forces fallback
statement: Let $F$ be a code format with guard parameter $g$, and let $\alpha$, $b$, and $r$ be finite Boolean words. Suppose paired decoding of $\alpha$ succeeds with components $b$ and $r$, and let $m$ be the natural number represented by $b$ in least-significant-bit-first binary. If $|r| < g(m+1)$, then decoding $\alpha$ by $F$ returns the fallback code of $F$.
hypotheses_covered: Paired decoding of $\alpha$ succeeds with components $b$ and $r$
The length of $r$ is less than the guard of $F$ times one plus the natural number represented by $b$ in least-significant-bit-first binary
